svg.title: Saint-Louis II
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and interpretive colors; not a facsimile. The adjacent primary1973text explicitly states Kelly painted this relief white. Nine horizontal incised grooves and three upper trapezoid fragments observed in the complete opposite plate. Pale same-family gray lines indicate relief shadow, not black pigment; external book page omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://assets.moma.org/documents/moma_catalogue_2535_300299040.pdf#page=30; record moma1973-pdf29-caption1; visual review 2026-10-28. Pure-vector study.
